children: A consortium of 10 banks has provided Crux AI with a $22 billion chip-backed loan, according to Dealroom.co citing Bloomberg. According to ChainCatcher, the financing will be used to buy Google custom TPUs.

Crux AI is a joint AI cloud services venture announced in May by Blackstone and Alphabet and officially launched last week. The company has also received a $5 billion equity investment from Blackstone, while Google will provide TPUs, software, and services. The venture plans to bring its first 500-megawatt capacity online in 2027.
Named lenders include Goldman Sachs, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp., Barclays, BNP Paribas, and Bank of Nova Scotia.

title: Banks Provide $22 Billion Chip-Backed Loan to Crux AI
